SELECT 
    e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME AS alarm_type, 
    COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
FROM 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n
JOIN 
    event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID
WHERE 
    n.HOST_NAME = 'ciscoA' 
    AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01')
    AND e.EVENT_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
GROUP BY 
    e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME;

SELECT 
    t_gn_topo_device.device_name AS device_name,
    t_bz_config_customer.customer_name AS customer_name
FROM 
    t_gn_topo_device
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer ON t_gn_topo_device.customer_id = t_bz_config_customer.customer_id
WHERE 
    t_gn_topo_device.device_status = 'down'
    AND t_gn_topo_device.update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS customer_count FROM t_bz_config_customer WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root WHERE IS_DELETED = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root 
WHERE IS_ONLINE = 1 
AND ONLINE_CHANGE_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') 
AND ONLINE_CHANGE_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01');

SELECT 
    eh.EVENT_NAME AS 告警类型,
    eh.EVENT_TIME AS 告警时间,
    eh.ALARM_REC_TIME AS 恢复时间
FROM 
    event_history_sdwan eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ci ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = ci.NE_ID
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer cu ON ci.CUSTOMER_ID = cu.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE 
    cu.CUSTOMER_ID = <指定的客户ID> AND
    eh.ALARM_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);
